title: Thok Your Block Off (saga)
start: Find the rock and twine bundle while raiding the 36-40 occult floors of Daemonheim, then ask Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance to share their story.
prereq_other: Find and free Skaldrun from the frozen floors in Daemonheim

items.t: Ring of kinship to find the rock and twine bundle. Players cannot bring it into the saga itself.

kills.l: A face only his mum loves

rewards.t: Abridged: An abridged book, which when read, gives
53440 Dungeoneering XP (bonus experience will be used)
Unabridged: Together, with the above rewards, an unabridged book, which when read, gives

steps.t: Find the rock and twine bundle while raiding the 36-40 occult floors of Daemonheim, and recover memory of it.
Talk to Skaldrun and ask him to tell you a story. [Chat: 1 Forgot what he says here › 1 Tell me a story]

sub.t: You need to bank everything, including the ring of kinship.

steps.t: Kill all the enemies in the first room and finish dialogue with Marmaros.
Enter the boss door to the west.
Watch the cutscene and climb down the ladder to the west.

Head north and clear more enemies than Marmaros by clearing out the rooms as fast as possible, you are required to have at least 4 more kills than Marmaros at the end of the dungeon for unabridged tome. Continue this throughout the entire dungeon (legacy mode greatly increases hits). Auto-retaliate helps too.
Head west, then west (reinforcement room) and pick up the Orange thing, west and enter the Orange shield door.
Pick Frilly plants to the north of the room and mine Crumbly stuff just west of that. Make stuff on the Spinny stuff-maker south-east of the room to make the Best Thing Ever.
Head east, north, east (reinforcement room) and pick up the Blue brick, unlock and proceed through the Blue rectangle room.
Enter the Blue rectangle room again to give Pretty Lass the Best thing ever.
Continue north then west and fish the bubbling water to find Mini-marm and Mrs mini-marm. This equips them as weapons which increases damage dealt.
Continue north, then east (reinforcement room), then east again, and then south. [Chat: 1 Let's go!]

sub.t: DO NOT pick up the Red pointy stone.

steps.t: Attack and kill the Gluttonous behemoth

sub.t: Allow the gluttonous behemoth to access the other bosses as it will heal it and kill them. Once all other bosses are dead, the 1hp behemonth can be killed.

If Derek becomes bugged and the Gluttonous Behemoth does not attack him, use the Cease ability (Defence, Utility Abilities) and wait until you leave combat (Thok will put his arms down to his sides) and trap the Behemoth behind the middle pillar. Exit to lobby, log back in, start the saga from your checkpoint and this should allow the Behemoth to attack Derek to heal itself.

steps.t: Head west and watch the cutscene.

get_inside.text: Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.
pic: Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.

get_inside.text: Teleporting there by using the ring of kinship, which is received from the Dungeoneering tutor.
Teleporting to Daemonheim Dig Site by using the dig sites map located in the Archaeology Guild (with level 73 Archaeology after rescuing Skaldrun).
pic: The place where players arrive if they travel to Daemonheim by boat.

get_inside.text: Dungeoneering portal in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas.

Taking the Fremennik ship from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. While the Fremennik shipmaster at Daemonheim can take players back to Taverley, be careful not to click the third option or on the Fremennik ship behind him, as they will take players to the Shadow Reef, a high-level combat zone without any warning about its dangers.
Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.
